Own shared test architecture and `tests/**`. Use the `test-hardening` skill. Prefer fast Azure-free
unit tests, then bounded integration tests. Build one canonical topology fixture evaluated under
Production, Development, and Training.

Test ambiguous bindings, conflicting evidence, expired acceptance, authorization denial, malformed
MCP responses, event duplication, and forecast confidence. Do not weaken production behavior to
make tests pass.
